structs.size_evidence: NOT PROVEN. Lower bound 22584: DWLogin slot 0 spans 22488..22584 (GetLogin@0x140F6B4A0 returns this + 96*idx + 22488), and the read at 22576 (login[0]+88) from A153 lies inside it. Upper bound 24456 only if DWServicesAccess is a prefix of OnlineMgr (see notes): OnlineMgr::ControllerFrame@0x14104FF10 and OnlineMgr::OnDisconnect@0x14104FF50 read m_firstSystem at [rcx+5F88h] = 24456 from the same base address that DWServicesAccess::GetInstance@0x140F6B490 returns (lea rax, g_onlineMgr_0 = 0x14C3851A0). Candidate 23256 = 22488 + 8*96 (game-test login count) is NOT proven: nothing in Replay bounds the login array. The login index is unbounded in GetLogin, GetEnvironment, GetEnvironmentString, GetClientID_0 and GetTitleID (their search loops run index 0..255 with a wrap check `++v != 0`), so those loops are not evidence of an 8-entry or 256-entry array.

structs.notes: Open question resolved: DWServicesAccess::GetInstance@0x140F6B490 is a single `lea rax, g_onlineMgr_0` and returns the OnlineMgr singleton itself (the IDA global g_onlineMgr_0 at 0x14C3851A0, type struct OnlineMgr, 24480 bytes). It is not a separate object: 31 Replay sites pass 0x14C3851A0 as struct OnlineMgr * (for example CL_Mgr_ActivateClient@0x140D66AC0 -> OnlineMgr::OnSignedIn(&g_onlineMgr_0)), and 60 GetInstance call sites use the same pointer as DWServicesAccess * (for example DWServicesAccess_GetEnvironmentKind@0x140E4BF10). So in Replay DWServicesAccess sits at OnlineMgr+0. That contradicts the game-test embed (OnlineMgr.m_dwServiceAccess at +1880, which is inside OnlineMgr's m_errorManager span in IDA's current layout). The IDA OnlineMgr fields at +0 (analyticsFnFMode), +8 (m_auth) and +0x10 (m_errorManager, 1864 bytes) therefore cannot all be OnlineMgr's own if DWServicesAccess is a prefix; OnlineMgr is owned by A164 and must be rebuilt from Replay (m_firstSystem +24456, m_currentSystem +24464 are the proven Replay tail). Base-class versus first-member cannot be decided from code: I recommend the coordinator treat it as `OnlineMgr` deriving from DWServicesAccess (matches the static accessor returning the derived singleton), but this is UNCONFIRMED. The decompiler label `g_onlineMgr_0.m_errorManager.m_shouldReportLastRecordedError` on GetInstance's lea is inconsistent with the lea target (the target is the object base, which IDA's OnlineMgr layout puts at analyticsFnFMode), so do not trust that label. The IDA global name g_onlineMgr at 0x14C385198 is a different 4-byte unsigned int used by Online_MatchData_Load@0x14104F9F3 (write) and G_SaveMP_WriteMainStateField (read): it is misnamed for OnlineMgr. The renames below must be applied together (name collision). OnlineMgr itself is not my struct: its owner (A164) needs the Replay tail m_firstSystem at +24456 and the +0 base shared with DWServicesAccess.

renames: CL_Mgr_ActivateClient@0x140D66AC0 passes it to OnlineMgr::OnSignedIn; GetInstance@0x140F6B490 lea of this address; OnlineMgr::ControllerFrame@0x14104FF10 reads +5F88h from it. Apply only after the 0x14C385198 row frees the name
